as_told.title: Unblurred 2022 Google Earth imagery shows vehicle tracks around S4

plain: Satellite images of S4, a secret site in Nevada tied to the claims of a man named Bob Lazar, are said to have been covered up on Google Earth, the online map of satellite photos. Michels says the data shows "stuff they tried to cover up on Google Earth," and credits a documentary called Project Gravitar. An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb relays the work of another researcher, Luigi Vendittelli, who he says "painstakingly" tries to show how foliage was rearranged around S4 sites, which he places near Papoose Lake. In a later episode Michels explains that Vendittelli used Google Earth's older archived images to find a 2022 picture of the area taken before the site was blurred, showing vehicle tracks around S4. The tellers differ on details but all point to the same researcher and documentary. If true, it would suggest someone is hiding activity at the place Lazar describes.
